name: KC Co., Ltd.
summary: KC Co., Ltd. manufactures and distributes semiconductor systems, display systems, and electronic materials in South Korea and internationally. The company offers semiconductor equipment, including chemical mechanical polishing equipment, and wet cleaning systems. It also offers display equipment, such as wet station systems, atmospheric pressure plasma cleaners, CO2 cleaners, and coater and track systems that are used in LCD, LTPS, OLED, and flexible display panels; and slurries and additives. In addition, the company provides nano dispersion materials used in LCD and OLED films; and other solvent dispersion materials.
